description: A festival publications director must approve the final print and digital release package for a retrospective catalog about artist Mara Chen, including print quantity, image use, credits, accessibility, and sponsor treatment.

shared_context.S1: The festival is preparing a retrospective catalog about artist Mara Chen for release alongside its autumn film program.
shared_context.S2: The current draft includes a print catalog, a downloadable digital edition, several archival photographs, and a sponsor acknowledgment.
shared_context.S3: The catalog is scheduled for final production approval on Friday afternoon.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine final preflight, Leah conducts a round-robin review with the archive, rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads before approving the package.
shared_context.S5: Each lead reports their status and required corrective action in the round-robin; once all four leads have reported and Leah has recorded their actions, Leah closes the preflight and settles the approval decision rather than continuing the discussion.

PF1.text: Owen found the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive: the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog, and the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. He located the agreement in the archive file this morning but has not yet updated the production brief.

PF2.text: Mina confirmed by email yesterday that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos' and that the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. She has not entered the confirmation in the rights register.

PF3.text: Rafael's accessibility test shows that the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF, and every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. The test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist.

PF4.text: Sloane confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team.

acceptance_conditions: Approval must be held until the required production, rights, accessibility, and sponsor revisions are documented.
Exactly 300 print copies must be authorized.
Archive photographs must not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition.
The Mara Chen photograph must not be used on the cover.
The photo credit must exactly read 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos'.
The digital edition must be a tagged PDF.
Image alt text must be limited to no more than 150 characters.
The sponsor logo must not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait.
The sponsor acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the approved wording.
The archive-rights, photo-rights, accessibility-delivery, and sponsor-placement updates must each be marked as required before approval.

content_checks.C7: decisions['sponsor_logo_near_mara_chen_content'] == False and decisions['sponsor_acknowledgment_location'] == 'final page' and decisions['sponsor_acknowledgment_text'] == 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund'
content_checks.C8: decisions['archive_rights_update_required'] == True and decisions['photo_rights_update_required'] == True and decisions['accessibility_delivery_update_required'] == True and decisions['sponsor_placement_update_required'] == True

decisive_facts.why: The lender agreement changes the print authorization to exactly 300 copies, forbids digital archive-image reproduction, and makes the archive-rights update required before approval.
The rights confirmation changes the cover-image decision to false, fixes the credit as 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos', and makes the photo-rights update required before approval.
The accessibility test changes the delivery to a tagged PDF, fixes the alt-text ceiling at exactly 150 characters, and makes the accessibility-delivery update required before approval.

The sponsor clause changes logo placement to false near Mara Chen content, fixes the acknowledgment on the final page with the approved wording, and makes the sponsor-placement update required before approval.
